name: create_branch
description: Create a new branch from the latest checkpoint of a main Figma design file. This MUST NOT be used if the user wants to create a new file. This tool MUST ONLY be used if the user EXPLICITLY wants to create a new branch on an existing file. Branching is supported only for files on Organization and Enterprise plans. IMPORTANT: This tool only works for Figma design files (URL path `/design/`). It is NOT supported for FigJam (`/board/`), Slides (`/slides/`), Specs (`/spec/`), or Figma Make (`/make/`) files. The source must support branching and cannot already be a branch. Returns the new branch file key and URL.

sessionId.description: After create_session succeeds, pass its exact returned UUID here on every file-tool call for this task, even when fileKey differs.

fileKey.description: The main Figma design file key to branch. For a URL like https://figma.com/design/:fileKey/:fileName, use :fileKey. Existing branch keys are not supported.

branchName.description: The name for the new branch. Cannot be empty. Must contain a non-whitespace character.
